items.q: I don't have a card, what should I do?
items.a: Fill in the form above — we'll call you back ourselves. Opening a card is free.

items.q: I need cash. What's the benefit of a card?
items.a: You can withdraw the money from an ATM or pay with it directly in a store. The difference is the money is already yours — no need to wait in a branch queue.

items.q: What's the exchange rate? Is it different from getting cash?
items.a: The amount and rate are shown on screen before you tap "Accept". You see everything first and decide — if you don't agree, you simply don't accept it.

The money arrives on your own card through the bank's app. Only you can log into the app — with your password and an SMS code. Never share your SMS code with anyone; the bank will never ask for it either.
You are not charged any fee for accepting the transfer in the app. The transfer fee is paid by the sender.
As soon as the sender sends the transfer, it appears in the app. If you accept it, the money is on your card within 1 minute — even at night or on a day off.

items.q: Can I still collect it at a branch?
items.a: Yes, the old way still works: bring your passport to a branch and get cash. With the app, you don't need to go anywhere — the choice is yours.
